# Provenance + integrity record for the vendored report scripts (#332).
# The sha256s below are ENFORCED by report_issue332_test.go
# (TestVendoredReportScriptHashes) — an upgrade is a two-line diff here +
# the embed list + the template literals, and tampering in git is detectable.
#
# tailwindcss-3.4.16.js
#   source: https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.16
#   note: the Play CDN build — a runtime JIT CSS compiler, documented by
#         upstream as development-only. DESIGN TRADE-OFF (accepted, #332):
#         vendoring the compiler keeps the report self-contained (it is the
#         artifact cdn.tailwindcss.com serves; the only published form) at
#         the cost of ~451KB and a compiler-in-browser. A prebuilt CSS via
#         the tailwind CLI would be 10-30KB and drop one of the two inline
#         script blocks — recorded as the follow-up direction.
